summary_markdown: The conversation covered two main topics. First, [p1] requested an update to the calibration for specific locations (Transport Hub_telt200 and Taxi Rank_telt200) for company 7897 on a staging environment. This was completed by [me]. Second, [me] questioned [p1] regarding data received from CITYDATA for South Africa. While the client expected demographic data, the provided dataset contained session data (phone pings over a period). [p1] confirmed that previous engagements with CITYDATA had only involved session data, not demographics.
decisions: Calibration updates were applied to Transport Hub_telt200 and Taxi Rank_telt200 for company 7897 on staging.
